# Noah Kahan
Folk-pop singer-songwriter from Strafford, Vermont

<p class="tagline">"I'm not much of a romantic, I'm as cold as the water in the pool up in Vermont" — Stick Season</p>

![](hero-illustration.svg){.hero-illustration fig-alt="Illustration of a singer-songwriter with a guitar among Vermont pine trees at dusk"}

## About the Artist

Noah Kahan is an American singer-songwriter whose blend of folk instrumentation, self-deprecating lyricism,
and pop songcraft turned him into one of the breakout artists of the 2020s. Raised in Strafford, Vermont,
Kahan built a devoted online following before his 2022 album *Stick Season* became a cultural phenomenon,
soundtracking a wave of interest in "New England sad-boy" folk-pop and earning him a Grammy nomination for
Best New Artist.

His songwriting leans on the specifics of small-town New England life — snow, homesickness, strained family
relationships, and the ache of growing up — set against arrangements that borrow as much from The Lumineers
and Mumford & Sons as from mainstream pop radio.
